policy.name: Industrial and Investment Policy of Assam, 2019 (IIPA 2019), extended from 01.09.2024 until further notification; Amendment 2023 (mega projects only)
policy.order_no: No.CI.137/2017/661; extension ECF No.506470/118 dated 11.09.2024; amendment eFile No.261091/37 dated 17.02.2023

zones.general: Units in areas other than special parks
zones.park: Units in Plastic Park, Bamboo Park, Food Park, Tea Park and other parks developed by or in collaboration with State/Central Government

zone_lookup: Not district-based. 'park' applies if the unit is located in a State/Central Government (or collaborative) Plastic/Bamboo/Food/Tea or other industrial park (para 13.1 table).

schemes.name: IIPA 2019 SGST reimbursement - Micro
schemes.notes: 100% of SGST paid through debit in electronic cash ledger (s.49(1) Assam GST Act) for 15 years, ceiling = % of Fixed Capital Investment (P&M + land & building directly connected with manufacturing, para 12(e)). New units commencing commercial production during policy validity. Must continue production >=75% of preceding 5-yr average for next 5 years or refund. Eligibility Certificate required (apply within 6 months, para 15). Negative list Annexure I. Policy originally 5 years from 01.09.2019; extended from 01.09.2024 'until further notifications' (ECF No.506470/118, 11.09.2024).

schemes.name: IIPA 2019 SGST reimbursement - Small
schemes.notes: As for micro; ceiling 150% (general) / 180% (park) of FCI.

schemes.name: IIPA 2019 SGST reimbursement - Medium
schemes.notes: Medium & Large: 150% of FCI in both general and park locations.

schemes.name: IIPA 2019 Power subsidy
schemes.notes: Rs 2.00 per unit consumed for 5 years from commercial production; cap Rs 50 lakh PER ANNUM and not exceeding 100% of P&M investment (whichever less). APDCL connection only (no open access/captive). Aggregate of all para-14 incentives capped at 100% of FCI (excl. SGST).

schemes.name: IIPA 2019 Technology transfer & quality certification (BIS/ISO/FSSAI/ZED etc.)
schemes.notes: Fees for BIS/ISO/FSSAI/AGMARK/HALLMARK/SILK MARK/ZED certification and technology transfer/know-how: 75% up to Rs 10 lakh per unit.

other_benefits: No state capital investment subsidy for MSMEs under IIPA 2019 (Annexure II only lists the central NEIDS 2017 capital subsidy); see central UNNATI 2024 (central-ne.json).
DG set subsidy: 50% of generating set cost up to Rs 20 lakh (para 14.2).
Stamp duty: 100% reimbursement up to Rs 25 lakh, not for agricultural land / urban manufacturing land (para 14.3).
SME exchange listing: 30% of public issue expenses up to Rs 5 lakh (para 14.6).
Effluent treatment plant: 50% of capital cost up to Rs 25 lakh (para 14.7).
Employment: one-time Rs 10,000 per local youth employed (para 14.10(a)).
Mega projects (>= Rs 100 crore, 200 jobs): customised package (Amendment 2023, para 14.9).

IIPA 2019 Interest subsidy on WORKING CAPITAL loan: working-capital interest subsidy (not a term loan). 2% on outstanding WORKING CAPITAL loan (not term loan) for 5 years, subject to a ceiling of Rs 50 lakh (text does not say per annum; treat as total) and not exceeding 100% of P&M investment.
